_comment: Sound library for reels. generate-sfx.mjs creates any that are missing from public/sfx/ and skips the rest, so re-running costs nothing.

effects.name: ui-click
effects.prompt: A clean, crisp, subtle modern digital UI mouse click pop sound effect

effects.name: whoosh
effects.prompt: Short smooth air whoosh for a UI scene transition, soft and clean, no music, no reverb tail

effects.name: pop
effects.prompt: Very short crisp bubble pop for a card appearing on screen, dry, minimal, no reverb

effects.name: type
effects.prompt: Short burst of soft mechanical keyboard typing, a few keystrokes, dry and close

effects.name: stamp
effects.prompt: A rubber stamp hitting paper once, firm thud with a short paper snap, dry, no reverb

effects.name: paper-pin
effects.prompt: A sheet of paper being placed on a cork board and a pushpin pressed in, soft paper rustle and a small tap

effects.name: ding
effects.prompt: A single soft pleasant confirmation chime, one clean bell note, modern UI success, no reverb

effects.name: swipe
effects.prompt: Quick short fabric swipe for text sliding into place, soft and dry, no music
